name: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
title: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
summary: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthe
